patterns.what_worked: Inspecting the dead attempt's files before editing kept all of its correct work (P1/P2/P3/P7/CD) and reduced the finisher job to three surgical fixes: the P6 dead hook (start call at the transition, Retail-gated like its sibling visuals), the P3 gate re-pointed at the landed C2 contract (st.lust_supported), and a conditional combat-exit pulse teardown that un-broke an existing bars_state glow pin. The real-module sandbox (compat+utils+twist+nextaction+paladin over frame stubs, hud_state pattern) let one suite pin behavior and wiring together.
patterns.what_was_hard: Throttled paths need clock discipline in tests: the 0.5 s lust/JotC/CD re-scan throttles and the quantised timer-text latch made three initial fixtures read stale state; every failure was a test-side timing mistake, not a code defect. bars_state cannot go green this wave by design (count reconciliation deferred), so 'all green' was scoped to the paladin-owned suites.
patterns.skill_gap: Offline harness cannot prove in-client id resolution (racial candidates, Holy Wrath ranks) or the real SWING_DAMAGE refresh cadence; those stay on the in-client list.
